landing.title: PurpleHere POS v3.16 Update — Floor Plan, Unit Numbering & Geographic Maps
landing.excerpt: Foodcourt operators get a visual Floor Plan editor, flexible Unit Numbering with range notation, and geographic Maps for both Brand franchises and Foodcourt tenancies. Plus Manager scope enforcement, Archive tabs, and auto-geocoded branch addresses.
landing.content:
## What's New

### Foodcourt Floor Plan — Visual Store Placement
- New drag-and-drop Floor Plan editor for foodcourt operators
- Place tenant stores on a 2D canvas with 4 shape options (rectangle, rounded, circle, triangle)
- Resize handles, undo/redo, and an Unplaced Stores panel for units not yet positioned
- One floor plan per branch, auto-created on first visit
- Read-only viewer shows layout with clickable stores revealing contract and tenant details
- Standalone full-screen window for focused editing

### Branch Unit Numbering — Flexible & Automated
- Configure unit numbers per branch with a zone-based editor
- Free-form textarea input — separate with commas or newlines
- Range notation auto-expands: `01-20` (20 units), `A01-A10` (10 units), `P-2-01A-05A` (5 units)
- Optional prefix per zone (e.g. `L1-`, `P-2-`)
- Preview before saving — contract-linked units are protected from deletion
- Saved units appear automatically in Contract dropdowns and Floor Plan Unplaced list

### Brand Franchise Map — Geographic Overview
- Interactive OpenStreetMap view of every restaurant under your brand
- Pin shape indicates relationship: ★ for franchise, ● for direct-operated
- Pin size scales with 30-day sales — spot top performers at a glance
- Pin color reflects restaurant status (active, pending, suspended)
- Dotted circles around franchise pins show territory radius from exclusivity terms
- Side panel with restaurant detail, contract summary, and sales on click
- Multi-brand dropdown sorted by restaurant count
- Opens in a standalone window for full-screen viewing

### Foodcourt Tenancy Map — Branch Occupancy at a Glance
- Each foodcourt branch pinned on the map with occupancy percentage label
- Click a branch to see its tenant restaurants with contract status and sales
- Compare branch performance across cities and regions
- Auto-geocoded addresses via OpenStreetMap (manual lat/lng override available)

### Manager Permission Enforcement
- Foodcourt Managers with a branch assignment now only see data for that branch (contracts, invoices, units, restaurants)
- Brand Managers assigned to a specific brand are scoped to that brand
- Applies across five backend routes for consistent data isolation

### Archive Tabs for Contracts and Restaurants
- Contract list now has Active and Archive tabs — terminated, expired, renewed contracts stay out of the way
- Restaurant list has Operational and Archive tabs — suspended tenants remain in Operational for payment visibility
- Stats cards show counts per archive category

### Sidebar Navigation
- New Foodcourt menu items: Tenancy, Branch Map, Floor Plan
- New Brand menu item: Franchise Map
- Map and Floor Plan views open in their own window for distraction-free navigation

### Plan Coverage
- All new features included in Brand Basic / Professional / Enterprise and Foodcourt Basic / Professional / Enterprise at no extra cost
- Floor Plan depends on Branch Management as an auto-activated prerequisite

notice.title: PurpleHere POS Update v3.16
notice.content_en:
1️⃣ Foodcourt Floor Plan — Visual Store Placement

Drag-and-drop editor with 4 shape options. One floor plan per branch, auto-created on first visit. Read-only viewer reveals contract + tenant info on click. Opens in a standalone window.

Location: Foodcourt → Floor Plan

2️⃣ Branch Unit Numbering — Free-form with Range Expansion

Configure units per branch with zone cards. Optional prefix + textarea input with ranges: 01-20, A01-A10, P-2-01A-05A auto-expand. Contract-linked units are protected from deletion. Preview before save.

Location: Foodcourt → Branches → Edit → Unit Numbering section

3️⃣ Brand Franchise Map

Every restaurant pinned on an interactive map. Pin shape (★ franchise / ● direct), pin size (30-day sales), color (status), and territory radius (exclusivity terms) give a complete geographic view. Multi-brand dropdown supported.

Location: Brand → Franchise Management → Map tab, or sidebar "Franchise Map"

4️⃣ Foodcourt Tenancy Map

Branch pins labeled with occupancy %. Click a branch to list its tenants. Auto-geocoded addresses via OpenStreetMap.

Location: Foodcourt → Tenancy → Map tab, or sidebar "Branch Map"

5️⃣ Manager Scope Enforcement

Foodcourt Managers assigned to a branch see only that branch's data. Brand Managers assigned to a brand see only that brand. Applies to contracts, invoices, units, restaurants, branches.

6️⃣ Archive Tabs

Contract and Restaurant lists now have Active / Operational vs Archive tabs. Terminated, expired, and renewed records stay out of the main workflow.

All features are included in your current Brand or Foodcourt plan at no extra cost.
notice.content_ko:
1️⃣ 푸드코트 평면도(Floor Plan) — 시각적 매장 배치

드래그 앤 드롭 에디터. 4가지 도형 (사각형, 라운드, 원, 삼각형). 지점당 1개 평면도, 첫 방문 시 자동 생성. 읽기 전용 뷰에서 매장 클릭 시 계약/입점사 정보 표시. 독립 창에서 편집.

위치: 푸드코트 → Floor Plan

2️⃣ 지점 유닛 번호 — 자유 입력 + 범위 자동 확장

지점별로 Zone 카드로 유닛 번호 설정. 선택 prefix + textarea 자유 입력. 범위 표기 자동 확장: 01-20, A01-A10, P-2-01A-05A. 계약 연결된 유닛은 삭제 보호. 저장 전 Preview 가능.

위치: 푸드코트 → Branches → 편집 → Unit Numbering 섹션

3️⃣ 브랜드 프랜차이즈 지도

모든 레스토랑을 인터랙티브 지도에 표시. 핀 모양(★ 프랜차이즈 / ● 직영), 핀 크기(30일 매출), 색상(상태), 영역 반경(독점권 조건)까지 한눈에 확인. 다중 브랜드 드롭다운 지원.

위치: 브랜드 → Franchise Management → Map 탭, 또는 사이드바 "Franchise Map"

4️⃣ 푸드코트 입점 지도

지점 핀에 점유율% 표시. 지점 클릭 시 입점 매장 목록. OpenStreetMap 자동 지오코딩.

위치: 푸드코트 → Tenancy → Map 탭, 또는 사이드바 "Branch Map"

5️⃣ 매니저 접근 제한 강제화

지점이 할당된 Foodcourt Manager는 해당 지점 데이터만, 특정 브랜드가 할당된 Brand Manager는 해당 브랜드 데이터만 조회 가능. 계약/인보이스/유닛/레스토랑/지점 5개 영역에 적용.

6️⃣ Archive 탭

계약/레스토랑 목록에 Active/Operational vs Archive 탭 분리. 종료/만료/갱신된 항목은 Archive로 이동하여 주요 작업 흐름을 방해하지 않음.

모든 신규 기능은 현재 사용 중인 Brand/Foodcourt 플랜에 추가 비용 없이 포함됩니다.
